notes.title: Version 0.14b is live!
notes.content:
Patch Notes

Adjustments and Fixes

     [Bugs] Various bug fixes, including performance issues.
     [Camera] The camera controls have been adjusted for keyboard and mouse.
     [Stats] Fiona has a d20 rolls of: Str 3, Dex 19, Con 10, Int 3, Wis 12, Cha 7.
     [Stats] Fiona weighs 4 kg.
     [Gameplay] Fiona’s physical push velocity (ppv) is now 3.25 m/s, down from 4.5 m/s.
     [Gameplay] Fiona’s magical push velocity (mpv) is now 3.25 m/s.
     [Gameplay] Normal jump is 100% of ppv.
     [Gameplay] Double jump is 140% of ppv.
     [Gameplay] Triple jump is 170% of ppv.
     [Gameplay] Long jump pushes the player forward with 70% ppv and up with 160% ppv.
     [Gameplay] Wall jump pushes the player forward with 50% ppv and up with 125% ppv.
     [Gameplay] Leap was reduced from 225% to 190% of ppv
     [Gameplay] Evocation: Gust of Air pushes the player forward with 40% mpv and up with 75% mpv.
     [Gameplay] Transmutation: Minor Levitation pushes the player up with 100% mpv.
     [Nature] All nature assets have been replaced.
     [UI] Controls menu panel has been updated.
     [VFX] FX has been overhauled.

notes.title: New Content
notes.content:
Patch Notes
New Features

     [New Items] Emerald Ring, Sapphire Necklace, Wooden Duck
     [New Scene] The door to the Environment Simulator, aboard the Zaftig 25, is now unlocked!
     [New Scene] Simulated Environment: Obstacle Course
     [New Scene] Simulated Environment: Cubulation

Adjustments and Fixes

     [Camera] Camera behavior has been adjusted.
     [Lighting] Most lights have been adjusted.
     [Build] Build times have been reduced.
     [Lighting] Lightmap settings for many objects have been adjusted.
     [Shaders] Vegetation shaders have been replaced
     [Shaders] Moss Layers now properly render in The First Tree
     [UI] Menus have been improved.


Please leave feedback here!
